scope: $T type parameters on procedure signatures: lexed as one token, parsed as a type node, bound by the checker at the first parameter use as a placeholder type owned by the procedure and checked at every other use. Refused forms have their own explained codes. No instantiation: every call is E0397 and generic procedures are never emitted.

new_rules: LX_Kind.k_dollar (53): '$' followed by a name, text is the name
CK_Site and CK_State.generic/site: which procedure owns $T and whether a position may bind it
CK_type_param (E0392 only in result, E0393 unbound, E0395 struct field)
CK_call_bound (E0396 recursion, E0397 instantiation not yet supported)
E0398 #export_c generic, E0399 size_of/type_info/type_name of a placeholder
== and != refuse placeholders (E0311); Metal profile skips generic procedures
checker.checks: 587 checks, 587 passed (11 fixtures generated from real parser output plus unit #forall/#test)
